title: DTEP-S Entitlement Credential
description: Base schema for W3C VC 2.0 entitlement credentials issued under the Digital Transaction Evidence Protocol — Social Layer (DTEP-S). Domain-neutral: entitlement type and delivery parameters are Issuer-defined extensions.

@context.description: JSON-LD context. Must include W3C VC v2 and DTEP-S context URIs.

type.description: Credential type. Must include both VerifiableCredential and DTEPEntitlementCredential.

id.description: Globally unique credential identifier. Recommended format: urn:uuid:{uuid-v4}.

issuer.description: Credential issuer. Either a DID string or an object with id property.

expirationDate.description: ISO-8601 datetime of credential expiration. Must be explicitly set. Must be strictly after issuanceDate.

credentialSubject.description: The credential subject — the beneficiary holding this entitlement.

id.description: Subject identifier. May be a DID, pseudonym, or opaque Issuer-assigned identifier. Real identity is never required in the credential.

entitlement.description: The entitlement object. Defines the right, its validity, and redemption policy. Domain-neutral.

type.description: Issuer-defined entitlement type string. Protocol does not constrain values. Examples: humanitarian.accommodation, social.food_delivery, education.canteen, health.pharmacy.

issuerRef.description: Issuer-internal reference. Links credential to Issuer registry without exposing PII.

validFrom.description: ISO-8601 datetime. Entitlement validity start. Must not precede issuanceDate.

validUntil.description: ISO-8601 datetime. Entitlement validity end. Must not exceed expirationDate.

extensions.description: Issuer-defined domain-specific parameters. No schema constraints. Must not duplicate base schema field names.

redemptionPolicy.description: Rules under which a Redemption Event is valid for this credential.

maxRedemptions.description: Maximum total redemptions allowed. Omit for unlimited.

unit.description: Issuer-defined unit string. Examples: night, meal, kg, unit.

requiresPresence.description: If true: Holder must be physically present at delivery point. Default: true.

allowedVerifiers.description: Optional constraint on which Verifiers may redeem this credential.

accreditationIds.description: Optional list of specific accreditation identifiers. Omit to allow any Verifier under the scheme.

verifierCategories.description: Optional list of Issuer-defined category strings. Omit to allow all categories.

biometricBinding.description: Present only when Holder has enrolled biometric data. Absence indicates no biometric enrollment — Verifier must use alternative presentation path.

templateId.description: Opaque identifier of enrolled template. Does not contain or allow reconstruction of biometric data.

templateLocation.description: credential: protected template vector stored in this credential. verifier-local: template stored in Verifier device registry, referenced by templateId.

templateVersion.description: Pipeline version string identifying the biometric pipeline used for enrollment. Example: dtep-s-bio-v0.1.

enrollmentAssurance.description: HIGH: supervised enrollment at accredited enrollment point. MEDIUM: self-enrollment with institutional verification.

protectedTemplate.description: Present only when templateLocation is credential. Base64-encoded one-way transformed feature vector. Raw biometric cannot be reconstructed from this value.

proof.description: W3C Data Integrity proof. Ed25519 signature over canonicalised credential.

cryptosuite.description: Required. Ed25519 signature over canonicalised credential JSON-LD.

verificationMethod.description: Issuer key identifier. Must resolve to Issuer public key.
